paragraphs: A mammoth's head is dominated by a dome of bone above the eyes that no living elephant has, and the tusks curve inward far enough that they would have crossed in an old animal. Both features come from frozen specimens rather than from bones alone.
The model is very light at 6,034 polygons and 6,107 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, supplied as a head, and carries StemCell certification.
At $49 it suits palaeontology and education visualisation, museum and exhibition work, documentary graphics, game assets and editorial illustration. On sale since 2022.

The manul has the densest fur of any cat and pupils that stay round rather than slitting, which is unusual and probably related to living where there is almost no cover. It looks perpetually annoyed because the face is flattened to reduce heat loss.

The model holds 25,256 polygons and 19,012 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, in a walking pose. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification, and a furred build is offered separately.
At $49 it suits wildlife and nature visualisation, documentary and education work, conservation material, game creatures, advertising and editorial illustration. On sale since 2024.

Fishing oilskins are cut deliberately loose so that water runs off rather than in, and the bib is high because the work is done bent over a rail. The boots are separate for the same reason everything on a deck is: it has to come off fast.
The set holds 71,962 polygons and 72,631 vertices in quads and tris with overlapping UVs, supplied with the deck boots, and carries StemCell certification.
At $49 it suits maritime and industry visualisation, workwear and safety marketing, character wardrobe work, documentary material, film costume and editorial illustration. On sale since 2026.

An outboard is an entire drivetrain hanging off the transom. Engine, gearbox, propeller and steering are one unit, which is why a boat can be repowered in an afternoon and why the hull underneath never has to be opened.
The model is very light at 7,936 polygons and 8,705 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, in black, and carries StemCell certification.
At $49 it suits marine and boating visualisation, equipment marketing, e-commerce imagery, harbour and water scenes, game environments and editorial illustration. On sale since 2025.

The compound microscope has not changed shape in a century because the optical path cannot be folded any tighter. Stage, objectives, tube and eyepiece have to sit in that order, and everything else on the instrument is a handle for adjusting one of them.
The model holds 71,683 polygons and 78,281 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, textured with 12 maps all at 2048x2048. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $49 it suits laboratory and education visualisation, scientific equipment marketing, e-commerce imagery, medical and research scenes, film props and editorial illustration. On sale since 2015.

Aircrew helmets are fitted individually, because a helmet that moves under acceleration is worse than none at all. The visor, the oxygen mask fittings and the communications are all mounted to a shell that has been shaped to one person's head.
The model holds 34,800 polygons and 35,712 vertices in quads and tris with overlapping UVs. It is built to CheckMate specification.
At $49 it suits aviation and defence visualisation, equipment marketing, character accessories, training material, film props, game assets and editorial illustration. On sale since 2026.

A cycling helmet is mostly air. The vents are structural as well as cooling, the foam is designed to be destroyed once, and the whole object is a calculation about how much protection people will actually agree to wear.

The model is very light at 11,290 polygons and 11,490 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, textured with 4 maps all at 4096x4096, in a generic scheme with no branding. It carries StemCell certification.
At $49 it suits sports equipment and retail visualisation, e-commerce imagery, character accessories, urban and cycling scenes, game assets and editorial illustration. On sale since 2020.

A lift car is one of the most constrained interiors anybody designs. Fixed dimensions, mandatory handrail heights, a mirror to make the space feel larger and a ceiling that has to hold both lighting and an escape hatch.
The model is very light at 11,623 polygons and 13,082 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, supplied with interior. It is built to CheckMate specification.
At $49 it suits architectural and interior visualisation, building services presentation, film and television sets, game environments and editorial illustration. On sale since 2024.

The tablet till replaced the cash register by being cheaper, smaller and updatable, and it moved the transaction to wherever the customer is standing. The stand is doing most of the work: it has to swivel, lock and survive being knocked.

The model holds 49,468 polygons and 51,584 vertices, built in quads only with non-overlapping UVs, textured with 10 maps, 5 at 4096x4096 and 5 at 2048x2048, in a generic unbranded scheme. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $49 it suits retail and hospitality visualisation, payment technology marketing, interface mockups, counter and interior scenes, film props and editorial illustration. On sale since 2018.

The oscillating tool cuts by vibrating a blade through a tiny arc, which sounds feeble and is the only way to make a plunge cut into a wall without a guard, a guide or a hole to start from. It is the tool that fixes what other tools cannot reach.
The model is light at 47,222 polygons and 49,254 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs. It is built to CheckMate specification.
At $49 it suits tool and equipment marketing, workshop and renovation visualisation, e-commerce imagery, training material, film props and game environments. On sale since 2025.

The tubes under a marimba are not decoration, they are tuned resonators, each one cut to the length that reinforces the bar above it. That is why the instrument gets physically larger towards the bass end far faster than the bars themselves do.
The model holds 144,866 polygons and 149,578 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs. It is built to CheckMate specification.
At $49 it suits musical instrument marketing, e-commerce and retail imagery, concert and rehearsal scenes, education material, film props and editorial illustration. On sale since 2025.

A folding stock exists for getting in and out of vehicles, not for firing. The rifle is shorter by a third with it closed, which matters enormously to anybody carrying one in a hatch, and matters not at all once they are outside.
The model holds 158,823 polygons and 81,859 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, with the stock folded, and carries StemCell certification.
At $49 it suits defence visualisation, documentary and news graphics, game weapons, film props, simulation and editorial illustration. On sale since 2024.

A header that folds is a header that can be driven between fields. Semi folded is the transport position, and the whole hinge arrangement exists because the working width of modern equipment is wider than any road it has to travel on.
The model holds 297,020 polygons and 285,888 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, in new condition and the semi folded position. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $49 it suits agricultural machinery marketing, harvest and farming visualisation, training material, documentary work, film backgrounds and game environments. On sale since 2023.

The indoor grill exists because most people cannot barbecue where they live. The whole engineering problem is getting a grill hot enough to mark food while extracting the smoke that would otherwise fill a kitchen.
The model is light at 57,012 polygons and 29,477 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs. It is built to CheckMate specification.
At $49 it suits kitchen and appliance visualisation, e-commerce and retail imagery, advertising, food and interior scenes, film props and editorial illustration. On sale since 2023.
